rule: Section 11: each model's stated training cutoff from its provider's published documentation. A unit is leak-exposed for a model whose cutoff falls after the unit's plan date; a month-stated cutoff covers that whole month. A model with no published cutoff runs, with that limit stated beside its results.

particle.note: Particle's model catalog, read 2026-11-08, states no knowledge or training cutoff for particle-1. It runs with that limit stated beside its results.
